parsed.subject: Collaboration Opportunity for a Graza Instagram Post
parsed.body:
Hi Graza team,

We’re a small Instagram content studio dedicated to bringing the joy of culinary experiences to your audience. We’d like to propose a collaborative Instagram post built around the fact that Graza started with Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) but also has a playful and culinary-inspired social presence. You've mentioned that Graza's social content, product design, and messaging are intentionally playful and over-the-top, rather than overly formal, which makes it a unique and engaging way to connect with consumers. Essentially, Graza has cultivated a community through their playful approach to social media, and we believe a collaborative post with them would be a fantastic way to showcase this aspect of your brand. This post would feature a visually appealing slide showcasing Graza's playful approach, paired with a call to action to engage with your audience on Instagram.

The BrandPilot team
